tools.name: discover_ai_products
tools.description: Search tasarim.ai's published catalog using concise product names, categories or needs. Category and text matches identify catalog records; verified task filters require stored field evidence. Returns claim scopes, recorded limitations, explicit unknowns and language fallback. Raw unverified descrip

tools.name: compare_ai_products
tools.description: Compare two to four published catalog products using the same criteria. Distinguishes catalog-record values from verified field evidence and unknowns. Includes stored claim scopes and recorded limitations; no invented scores, winner, pricing, or benchmarks. Use kind and slug returned by discovery.

tools.name: get_ai_product_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve stored field claims, source provenance and recorded limitations for one AI product. Catalog profiles are labeled as catalog records, not independent evidence. Provider/evidence commerce/tracking URLs are withheld with reasons. Optional first-party catalog links may carry a fixed visit marke
